title: When Can You Trust Your Synthetic Users? Diagnostics and Corrections for LLM Consumer Panels
abstract: arXiv:2609.13148v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as synthetic consumer panels, promising $97\%$ cost reductions over traditional surveys. Yet aggregate validation metrics conceal systematic failures: variance compression, coefficient sign-flips, subgroup error balloons of 10--30 percentage points, and global corrections that worsen demographic bias. We provide a formal framework for deciding when to trust, correct, or abandon LLM-generated consumer data. The framework decomposes synthetic-panel bias into covariate and concept shift, develops testable diagnostics with interpretable decision thresholds, and supplies a doubly robust AIPW estimator requiring only a small calibration sample ($n = 50$-$300$). We validate on three testbeds. In controlled simulations the decision rule achieves $100\%$ accuracy (180/180 replications). On the American National Election Study with pre-existing LLM failures, it correctly flags heterogeneous concept

translated_title: 何时可以信任你的合成用户？LLM消费者小组的诊断与修正
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被部署为合成消费者小组，承诺相比传统调查可节省97%的成本。然而，总体验证指标掩盖了系统性失效：方差压缩、系数符号翻转、子群体误差膨胀达10-30个百分点，以及加剧人口统计学偏差的全局修正。我们提供了一个形式化框架，用于决定何时信任、修正或放弃LLM生成的消费者数据。该框架将合成小组偏差分解为协变量偏移和概念偏移，开发了具有可解释决策阈值的可检验诊断方法，并提供了一种仅需小规模校准样本（n = 50-300）的双稳健AIPW估计器。我们在三个测试平台上进行了验证。在受控模拟中，决策规则达到了100%的准确率（180/180次重复实验）。在存在既有LLM失效的美国全国选举研究数据上，该框架正确地标记了异质概念（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个形式化框架，将LLM合成消费者小组的偏差分解为协变量偏移和概念偏移，通过可检验的诊断指标和仅需50-300个样本的双稳健AIPW估计器，帮助研究者决定何时信任、修正或放弃LLM生成的调查数据。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a formal framework that decomposes synthetic-panel bias into covariate and concept shift, offering testable diagnostics and a doubly robust AIPW estimator requiring only a small calibration sample (n=50-300) to decide when to trust, correct, or abandon LLM-generated consumer data.
